Runes › Precision

Press the Attack

PrecisionKeystone

Hit an enemy champion with 3 basic attacks in a row to deal bonus damage. After that, all your damage is 8% higher until you leave combat with champions.

What it does

Hitting an enemy champion with 3 consecutive basic attacks deals 40 - 160 bonus adaptive damage (based on level) and amplifies your damage dealt by 8% until you leave combat with champions.

When to take it

Take it on champions who trade with quick basic attack combos and want to win short and medium fights in lane.

Good on

Lucian Miss Fortune Aphelios Teemo

Other Precision keystones

Lethal Tempo Fleet Footwork Conqueror
